queryOutcomes: Separate English and non-English control discovery queries were executed and their outcomes and actual URLs are recorded in city-6725-bethany.json. English first-party discovery identified the official Oklahoma County Assessor GIS route; the control language is not local to the United States and was not used to establish custodianship.
requestOutcomes: The official Bethany site returned HTTP 200. The official Oklahoma County assessor GIS route returned HTTP 403/no usable direct response from this workspace, and a second official assessor page returned no usable direct response. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, private token, unsafe field request, or TLS exception was used. No viewer JavaScript/configuration, schema, CRS, anonymous parcel ID, or geometry response was obtained.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if source-proven
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [35.5209240851647, -97.5965335936396] was preserved and not moved to force a parcel hit.
No exact-point lookup or map-extent conclusion was treated as evidence of citywide absence.
The official county GIS lead establishes a local county custodian, not a verified anonymous citywide parcel-vector feed.

qualification.reason: A local county cadastral custodian and official GIS lead were evidenced, but no anonymous public parcel ID-plus-geometry response, schema, CRS, or citywide open coverage was qualified.

uncertainty: The live county viewer may be available to ordinary users through a route blocked to this workspace. The block is recorded as unavailable evidence, not as proof that Bethany lacks cadastral parcels.
